diagnostics.message: When VPC subnets are configured, :resource.aws_lambda_function.ami_housekeeper must wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.ami_housekeeper_vpc_execution_role so its execution role has the EC2 network-interface permissions required for VPC provisioning. Referencing the role alone does not order the policy attachment.

:resource.aws_cloudwatch_event_target.ami_housekeeper can activate scheduled invocations before :resource.aws_lambda_permission.ami_housekeeper grants EventBridge invoke access. Order target creation after the permission to avoid failed initial deliveries.

:resource.aws_cloudwatch_event_target.ami_housekeeper should wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy.ami_housekeeper before enabling scheduled execution; otherwise the first cleanup invocation can run before its AMI-management permissions are installed.

:resource.aws_cloudwatch_event_target.ami_housekeeper should wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy.lambda_logging so scheduled invocations cannot start before the managed log group and logging permissions exist. The current dependencies allow target creation concurrently with logging setup.

When tracing is configured, :resource.aws_cloudwatch_event_target.ami_housekeeper should wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy.ami_housekeeper_xray so initial scheduled invocations have the configured X-Ray permissions.
